name: 8 of Swords
meaning_for_today: Today fate will confront you with a prohibition. You will feel tight and constrained, and other limitations may also occur. It is necessary to pull yourself together, take a step, and try to overcome this stage. If it seems that this constrained state has not gone anywhere, you will have to find another path. Just do not turn your fears into an endless series of problems; you just need to gather your courage. Perhaps on this day, you will feel full of complexes, being naturally modest and shy. But if you fight with all your might to overcome your fears, it will be much easier to live in this world among people.
card_advice: It is not recommended to take on several things at once. You need to show a little patience and plan the sequence of your actions. Even if the situation is critical, do not lose face, panic, or fuss. The card may speak of financial losses, bad news, and other failures, but this is no reason to throw yourself into a panic. Sluggishness, inconsistency, contradictory actions, and the influence of surrounding people may be to blame for such a combination of circumstances. It may happen that due to your financial resources, you cannot afford what you dream of. But you have the opportunity to save up for an expensive purchase, so do not lose hope.

upright.short: Weakness, obstacles, beliefs, expectation of failure
upright.general: The card characterizes a person by their inconstancy and certain doubts. It signifies both external and internal factors that indicate a problem—these can be objective misunderstandings or those originating from the person themselves. The card can speak of a difficult situation, helplessness, capriciousness, limitations, a thorny path to one's goal, and being driven into a dead end, meaning it has many definitions. It should also be taken as a warning that unforeseen circumstances are coming that cannot be avoided. A person under the influence of this card is not free and depends on circumstances; they have deprived themselves of freedom and are ready to submit to someone else's rules and requirements, paying for their mistakes, recognizing and redeeming their guilt. Being a fairly wise individual, they can approach their problems philosophically.
upright.in_love: A problem exists in the relationship between two people. There is a destructive influence on a person's feelings and a clear incompatibility of characters. Moreover, neither partner wishes to yield to the other in the relationship. The marriage may end poorly since the relationship has already outlived itself. It is possible that the person deliberately distances themselves from their partner due to an inability to maintain the relationship, behaving infamously. In other words, a crisis occurs in the relationship; it hangs literally by a thread. This situation cannot be resolved because one of the partners does not want to preserve the union. It is impossible to keep two people together if they do not experience sincere feelings, joy, and love for each other. In such a family, quarrels, misunderstandings, and mutual attacks happen more and more frequently.
upright.in_situation: The individual experiences certain life difficulties, and their responsibilities are not yet clearly defined. Dealing with official duties will not be easy due to a lack of experience and competence. Perhaps they will treat themselves very critically because of their inexperience, thereby aggravating the problem even further. A situation involving litigation, financial losses, or bad news related to money matters is possible. The situation will be a dead end, as if one's hands are tied and nothing more can be done.

reversed.general: There is a saying: 'A spoonful of tar in a barrel of honey.' The reversed 8 of Swords is a spoonful of honey in a huge barrel of tar. This means that a person sees a little bit of positive aspect in a huge mass of negativity, which may be connected to past betrayal, hardships, hard work, depression, and unforeseen situations. However, there are bright sides that give the person hope. During a period of complete helplessness and despair, they can count on the ending of such restrictions. Even though positive changes will not solve all problems, one can at least count on the fact that some of them are already left in the past. Thanks to this, the person begins to believe in themselves and their success. The problems that seemed so global are actually not that scary. Along with this, freedom of action appears, fear is gone, and all limitations are nearing their end.
reversed.in_love: The card indicates reconciliation, when a person strives for it and tries to find a common language with a loved one. Indeed, the situation cannot be called a dead end; everything is resolvable if there is a desire. The card can also describe that one of the partners clearly pulls the blanket over themselves and is ready to make decisions for both. Negativity is present in the relationship, manifested through depression, unnecessary emotions, and anxiety. A person with a reversed 8 of Swords can behave differently: treating a loved one with prejudice, or treating themselves too honestly, which prevents them from building a relationship with their partner (as one wants not only to love but also to be loved).
reversed.in_situation: The card speaks of troubles that have already taken place. This can be related to professional activities as well as other situations. These problems spoil a person's overall picture but do not have a fatal significance. A boring period in life has begun, characterized by its monotony, which is actually a very difficult phase. Naturally, the person will get out of this story, but it will happen very slowly—step by step. If material resources are managed wisely, and if one connects foresight and prudence, success will definitely come.
